query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.cardNumber, COUNT(ph.id) as price_count, MIN(ph.soldAt) as earliest_date, MAX(ph.soldAt) as latest_date
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN priceHistory ph ON c.id = ph.cardId AND ph.source = 'snkrdunk' AND ph.grade = 'PSA10' AND ph.soldAt >= '2026-01-01'
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Pikachu%' AND c.cardNumber LIKE '%XY-P%'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.cardNumber
ORDER BY price_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
